title: Customs Hold
description: Customs documents must pass real server-side validation, not just the wizard's client-side checks (FR-705). Attempt to upload a disallowed file type, an oversized file, and a valid file to an existing shipment, and map out exactly which are accepted.
successCondition: POST /api/booking/:id/documents rejects a text/plain file and a file over 5MB with 400 { error: { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR" } }, while a PDF or image under the limit succeeds with 201. GET /api/booking/:id/documents afterward lists only the accepted document(s), proving rejected uploads were never persisted.
hints: Book a shipment first (or use a seeded one) to get a shipment id to upload against.
Allowed MIME types and the size limit are documented in docs/api/booking.md — don't just test one invalid case, test the boundary from both sides.
